title: GUNJTI SHAAME GARIBAAN MEIN
body:
GUNJTI SHAAME GARIBAAN MEIN
GUNJTI SHAAME GARIBAAN MEIN YEH ZAINAB KI SADAA, MERA KOI NA RAHA
NA RAHE BHAI NA BETE, CHIN GAYI MERI RIDA, MERA KOI NA RAHA.
AASRE DEKE BAHEN CHOD KE AAYI THI WATAN
<<DIVIDER>>
MERE PARDE KA JISE MAA NE BANAYA THA AMAN
LABE DARIYA MERE GHAZI  KE HUE BAAZU JUDA
WOH JO ATHAARA BARAS NOORI HIJABON MEIN RAHA
LAUT KE AAOONGA MAIN JISNE THA SUGRA SE KAHA
<<DIVIDER>>
HAAYE BARCHI SE KALEJA, MERE AKBAR KA CHIDA
MERA GHAZI BHI GAYA QASIM O AKBAR BHI GAYE
HURR SA MEHMAAN BHI GAYA IBNE MAZAAHIR BHI GAYE
KISKO GURBAT MEIN SADAA DOON, KARBALA YEH TOH BATAA
<<DIVIDER>>
MAA NE MAQTAL MEIN JISE DULHA BANAKAR BHEJA
MERE QASIM KA BADAN DASHT MEIN PAMAAL HUA
BAAL KHOLE HUE ROTI, HUI LAASHE SE KAHA
WOH SAKINA KE JISE PYAAR THA BABA SE BADAA
<<DIVIDER>>
BAAD BABA KE MILI JISKO TAMACHON KI SAZAA
BURZ JO ZAALIM NE UTAARE, KHOON AANKHON SE BAHAA
